title: The Chess Game Begins
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji finally realized the source of that voice, an unfamiliar rune quietly emerged on the fifth page of the Tianji Record—was it the key to breaking his chains, or a deeper layer of fate's design?

text.content: In the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, mist draped over the abandoned spiritual herb garden like thin gauze. Moonlight pierced through the clouds, scattering mottled silver radiance across the withered yellow grass. Servant Disciple Chen Ji stood alone by the dry well, fingertips brushing the faded yellow fragment in his arms, his heartbeat still unsettled. The voice from moments ago still echoed in his ears—a name he had never spoken to anyone. Even Mo Xiansheng didn't know. Even his相依为命的妹妹 Chen Nian didn't know. Where had that voice come from? Why did it know the childhood name buried for ten years?

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered slightly, his voice low and wary) "That voice... this old man seems to have sensed it somewhere before. Young master, this is by no means ordinary—you must—" Before he could finish, the remnant soul fell silent once more, as if some force was deliberately blocking his perception.

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze darkened slightly. The Tianji Record always fell into silence after giving a warning—this was something he had long grown accustomed to. What truly chilled him was the voice's source—not from within the Tianji Record, but from... somewhere higher. An existence beyond the Tianji Record, beyond heaven's way itself. That thought sent a fine layer of cold sweat down his back. He drew a habitual deep breath, pressing all his emotions back into the deepest recesses of his heart. The expression of a废物杂役 was nothing more than cowardice and confusion.

dialogue.content: (Voice pressed extremely low, only audible to himself) "The chess game begins... so that's how it is." A self-deprecating arc curved at the corner of his mouth, "It seems I'm not the only one laying pieces." Brushing the nonexistent dust from his robe, Chen Ji turned and walked deeper into the spiritual herb garden. He had already sent the signal—two specially crafted transmission talismans, flying in different directions. One toward the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's peak, the other piercing through layers of barriers, vanishing into the night.

text.content: Half an hour later, inside a collapsed medicine hut at the deepest part of the spiritual herb garden. Moonlight filtered through the broken roof,勾勒出 on the ground an irregular circle. Three figures occupied three positions, wary of each other yet maintaining subtle tacit understanding. Su Qingyao wore plain white inner sect robes, her brow carrying a cold edge of scrutiny; Ye Qing was shrouded in faint black mist, the unique aura of the Demonic Path. And Chen Ji, still in that timid appearance, huddled in a corner, as if he might be blown away by the wind at any moment.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao spoke first, her voice cold as frost: "Chen Ji, you better give me a sufficiently weighty reason for me to risk crossing three sect barrier formations late at night to meet a '废物'." Her gaze was like a blade, "And—she pointed at Ye Qing, 'Demonic Path Saintess. What exactly are you trying to do?'

Ye Qing covered her lips and laughed softly, her voice echoing through the empty medicine hut with an indescribable nuance: "Why is Su Senior Fellow so tense? Since Chen Gongzi dared invite both of us simultaneously, he naturally has his reasons." She cast a sidelong glance at Chen Ji, a flash of inquiry in her eyes, "But honestly, I'm curious too. Wasteful servant... oh, what should I call you?"

choice.prompt: Facing the scrutiny of two supremely intelligent women, Chen Ji must choose how to begin—whether to continue feigning ignorance, or适当展示实力 to establish trust?

choices.text: Retreat to advance, throw out key intelligence
choices.description: Use a foresight piece of intelligence to open the situation, making them aware of the urgency so as to establish a trusting foundation for cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate for foresight
choices.visible_reward: Obtain initial trust and intelligence exchange from both allies
choices.risk_hint: Prematurely revealing foresight ability may trigger more doubts
choices.process_label: 陈机缓缓抬起头，眼中闪过一丝不属于废物的精光——那是只有真正掌控全局者才有的眼神。

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, those always-downcast eyes finally meeting both of theirs. In that instant, Su Qingyao's pupils slightly contracted—that gaze was too calm, too calm for what a servant disciple should possess. "Within three days," Chen Ji's voice was low and certain, "the Tianqing Sect will face a catastrophe. Han Lie from the Xuanwu Sect will come under the name of 'fair sparring,' and at that time..." He paused, "Elder Ling Yuan will personally appear."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's expression changed abruptly. She knew Chen Ji had hit the mark—just yesterday, she had indeed received the Xuanwu Sect's formal visit letter. "How do you know this?" Her voice carried a sharp edge, "A level of sect diplomacy like this is completely beyond an ordinary disciple's reach."

choices.text: Silent observation, letting the other party reveal their hand first
choices.description: Not rush to reveal oneself, but guide the conversation to make Ye Qing and Su Qingyao each reveal their stance and intelligence, then decide how much to disclose.
choices.visible_cost: Energy consumption of maintaining the废物 persona
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence from both parties without revealing the foresight ability
choices.risk_hint: May cause allies to think you have no value and leave
choices.process_label: 陈机依旧保持着那副懦弱的神态，只是眼角的余光不动声色地扫过两位来客的微表情。

text.content: Chen Ji shrunk his neck, his voice barely audible: "I... I don't know why either, just... just have a feeling something will happen." His performance was impeccable, that perfectly measured panic making anyone see a coward who had been scared out of his wits. Su Qingyao frowned, about to speak mockingly, when Ye Qing suddenly laughed lightly. "Interesting." Her gaze lingered on Chen Ji, "A servant disciple who can contact both me and the Inner Sect Senior Fellow late at night—are you certain you truly understand nothing?"

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing meaningfully approached Chen Ji, lowering her voice) "Chen Gongzi, your 'feeling' just saved your life. There is a traitor inside our Holy Sect, someone is searching for something—with an aura very similar to what you carry in your arms." She stepped back, "Now, do you still want to keep pretending?"

choices.memory_label: 夜清主动透露圣宗内鬼线索

text.content: A brief silence fell over the medicine hut. Moonlight cast intersecting shadows among the three, a subtle tension弥漫 in the air. Chen Ji could feel two distinctly different scrutinizing gazes—one cold as a sword, the other profound as an abyss. He had to find the balance between trust and concealment. Too much exposure would invite jealousy, too much concealment would make allies lose patience. This was a war without smoke, and he must become the one who controlled the rhythm.

dialogue.content: (Finally, Chen Ji raised his head, that cowardly expression fading somewhat) "Since both of you have come, you surely already have your own answers." His voice was still not loud, yet carried an unmistakable certainty, "The Xuanwu Sect's probe is only the beginning. Elder Ling Yuan... he will not let anyone who threatens his plans slip through." He looked at Su Qingyao, "Senior Fellow Su should know better than anyone how deep the waters run inside the Tianqing Sect."

text.content: Su Qingyao's gaze flickered. She did know some things—Elder Ling Yuan's actions had grown increasingly strange in recent years, his attitude toward sect affairs subtly shifting. But how could a servant disciple possibly know such internal matters? Unless... her gaze turned sharp, as if trying to see through Chen Ji entirely. "Who exactly are you?" The words escaped her lips before she even noticed the unusual quality in her own tone.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing suddenly raised her hand, black mist coalescing in her palm) "Senior Fellow Su, don't rush to conclusions." Her voice carried a playful nuance, "I actually think... this Chen Gongzi is far more interesting than we imagined." The black mist dispersed, revealing a glowing token in her hand—the Holy Sect's communication token, engraved with a rune Chen Ji knew all too well. "This is the thing you had someone deliver three days ago. In your letter, you said you had a way to free me from the Holy Sect's control." She直视ed Chen Ji's eyes, "I'm here. Now, tell me your筹码."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing has revealed her hand, Su Qingyao's suspicions are rising. Chen Ji must make a choice with limited information—how will this chess game's scales tip?

choices.text: Display core trump cards all at once
choices.description: Directly show both people the resonance signs of the Tianji Record's fifth page, using real interests to bind the three-party alliance—making them see the irreplaceability of cooperating with you.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose the existence of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Establish a true three-party alliance, obtain dual resource support from the Holy Sect and Inner Sect
choices.risk_hint: Once news leaks, will become the target of all
choices.process_label: 陈机缓缓从怀中取出天机录残页，淡淡的光芒在黑暗中亮起——那是超越普通灵器的波动。

text.content: The fragment glowed faintly under the moonlight, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura. Su Qingyao's pupils suddenly contracted—she had cultivated for many years and could immediately tell this was no ordinary technique or spiritual artifact, but rather something... beyond comprehension. Ye Qing's reaction was even more intense, the black mist around her surging violently as she gazed at the fragment with barely concealed shock. "This is... a heavenly object?" Her voice trembled slightly, "No wonder... no wonder you can foresee the future."

choices.text: Only disclose key information to Ye Qing
choices.description: Use Ye Qing's knowledge of the Holy Sect, only reveal part of the truth to her, keep Su Qingyao in the dark—making the Demonic Path Saintess a buffer layer.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger a trust crisis with Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage while obtaining key intelligence from within the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's suspicions may deepen, increasing cooperation costs later
choices.process_label: 陈机侧过身，将天机录的气息只向夜清的方向微微释放，同时对苏青瑶投去一个歉意的眼神。

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing shuddered, the black mist around her unconsciously forming and dispersing) "You..." Her voice was extremely low, "This thing's aura is exactly the same as the 'Tianji Record' recorded in Holy Sect texts." Her gaze became complicated, "No wonder they want to find it at any cost." She looked at Su Qingyao meaningfully, "Senior Fellow Su, it seems we've all been played by this '废物.' However—" she shifted gears, "This is exactly the ally I need."

Su Qingyao watched coldly. She wasn't foolish; Ye Qing's reaction said everything. This servant disciple was hiding a major secret, and she still hadn't seen through it. "Interesting." She snorted, "Chen Ji, you owe me an explanation."

choices.memory_label: 夜清确认天机录身份，苏青瑶被蒙在鼓里

text.content: At this moment, the Tianji Record fragment in Chen Ji's arms suddenly grew hot. On the fifth page, a faint rune appeared, emanating a light entirely different from before—it was a sign of resonance. Chen Ji's heart tightened. The fifth page had never actively responded to anything before—why would it suddenly undergo such a change now? Instinctively, he pressed his hand against the fragment, attempting to perceive the changes within.

dialogue.content: (A voice suddenly rang in his mind, unfamiliar yet familiar, youthful and clear, carrying a stubborn edge) "Brother... what are you hiding from me again?" The voice was neither Mo Xiansheng's aged tone nor the Tianji Record's cold mechanical sound, but... Chen Nian's voice. But she was clearly in the Holy Sect's hands and had never had the chance to contact him. Unless—Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, "Chen Nian? Is that you?" He下意识地 called out, his voice carrying a tremor he hadn't noticed himself.

Su Qingyao sharply caught Chen Ji's abnormality. This man who had always been calm and composed, his expression now actually showed a hint of... panic? "Chen Nian?" She frowned, recalling, "This name... I seem to have seen it in some sect archives. A servant disciple from your cohort, the one who disappeared ten years ago?" Her gaze turned sharp, "What is your relationship with her?"

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's voice appearing within the Tianji Record shattered all of Chen Ji's plans. He must decide—whether to continue hiding or confess? And how will this confession affect his relationship with his allies?

choices.text: Confess the truth that Chen Nian is his sister
choices.description: Admit the blood relation between Chen Nian and himself, and reveal the fact that she was taken by the Holy Sect—use real emotion to build deeper bonds of trust.
choices.visible_reward: Establish true emotional bonds with allies, Ye Qing may provide intelligence related to Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Exposing a weakness may give enemies an opening
choices.process_label: 陈机深吸一口气，做出了他从未设想过的决定——坦诚。

dialogue.content: (Voice somewhat strained) "Chen Nian... is my sister." The moment these words left his mouth, Chen Ji felt the boulder pressing on his heart loosen a corner. In ten years, he had never spoken of this to anyone, "Ten years ago she was taken by Holy Sect people, and I have been searching for her ever since." He looked at Ye Qing, "This is also the real reason I contacted you—I know where the Holy Sect is holding her."

(Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, her expression growing complicated) "Heavenly Fate Lock Key... so it's you." Her voice dropped, "I know where she is. The seventh level of the Holy Sect dungeon, used as a key to open some forbidden grounds." She looked at Chen Ji, her gaze holding something it never had before, "No wonder you spared no effort to deal with the Holy Sect. From the very beginning... it was all for her."

choices.memory_label: 首次向盟友坦白妹妹的存在

choices.description: Only admit knowing Chen Nian, but conceal the blood relationship—continue using rationality rather than emotion to maintain the alliance, avoiding exposing the true weakness.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to obtain intelligence about Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage, letting no one completely see through oneself
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's voice has already exposed her existence; concealment may backfire
choices.process_label: 陈机迅速收敛情绪，重新戴上那副淡然的面具。

dialogue.content: (Tone deliberately flat) "She is a... friend I met in the Servants' Quarters. Before she disappeared, she gave me some clues, and I've always wanted to find her." He avoided Su Qingyao's scrutinizing gaze, "That's all."

Su Qingyao laughed coldly. She didn't know Chen Ji was lying, but she could sense—this man was deliberately hiding something. "Chen Ji, I don't know what you're afraid of." She stood up, "But there is one thing I can tell you—if you truly want to deal with the Holy Sect, a Demonic Path Saintess alone won't be enough." She turned toward the door, "Three days later, the Xuanwu Sect people will come to the Tianqing Sect for 'sparring.' At that time... perhaps it will be an opportunity."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶察觉隐瞒但未追问

text.content: Only Chen Ji and Ye Qing remained in the medicine hut. Su Qingyao's footsteps faded into the distance, vanishing into the night. Moonlight filtered through the broken roof, casting mottled light across Chen Ji's face. He looked down at the Tianji Record fragment in his hand, the rune on the fifth page still faintly glowing. And Chen Nian's voice had fallen silent once more, as if everything just now was merely an illusion.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing walked to Chen Ji's side, her voice much softer) "You just said... 'that's all.'" Her gaze fell on that page of fragment, "But your heartbeat is quickening. The technique I cultivate can perceive minute emotional fluctuations." She paused, "She is not just a friend, is she? She's family." This was not a question, but a statement.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. He merely静静地 stared at the Tianji Record fragment in his hand, at that faint rune. After a long while, he spoke softly: "Her independent will is awakening." His voice carried a tremor he hadn't noticed himself, "The Tianji Record is a tool for foresight, but whenever she appears in the foresight scenes, the images are always blurred... if she can actively contact me, perhaps—" He didn't finish, but Ye Qing understood.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing remained silent for a long time before finally speaking) "The seventh level of the Holy Sect dungeon has extremely tight security—even if you knew the location, you couldn't get in." Her voice carried a subtle softness she rarely showed, "But I can help you." She looked at Chen Ji, "In exchange—you promised me you would free me from the Holy Sect's control." She extended her hand, "Our goals have been aligned from the start: destroy the Holy Sect. Now, cooperation officially begins."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at the hand Ye Qing extended. Under the moonlight, that hand was fair as jade, yet the fingertips carried a faint blackness—the marks of demonic cultivation. He knew this woman was far from simple—the position of Holy Sect Saintess had always been bought with countless lives. But at this moment, she chose to stand on his side. Perhaps it was a marriage of convenience, perhaps something deeper, or perhaps... just two people toyed by fate, finding each other in the darkness.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji reached out and lightly clasped Ye Qing's hand) "Pleasant cooperation." His voice returned to its usual calm, but something in the depths of his eyes微微波动—a warmth that hadn't existed in ten years. "The Xuanwu Sect's visit in three days is our first shared opportunity." He released her hand and turned to gaze at the night sky, "Before then, I need to do one thing." He looked at the Tianji Record in his arms, "Awaken the fifth page."

text.content: The rune on the Tianji Record's fifth page微微跃动 under Chen Ji's gaze, as if responding to his will. He knew the cost of awakening a new page—every evolution of the Tianji Record meant greater backlash. But at this moment, for Chen Nian, to break the invisible net shrouding everyone, he had to move forward. Mo Xiansheng's warning still echoed in his ears, heaven's eye's gaze prickled like芒刺, and the chess game beneath his feet was only beginning to reveal the tip of the iceberg.
